name: Leeandra
home: Swamp hut, half a day SW of Nebruz
found: Her swamp hut, tending a brew.
appearance: Swamp-worn leathers. Rings on every finger.
sayings: Caelrun thinks it tamed the swamp. The swamp agreed to be patient.
Some of them are hungry for you. They're proud of not eating.
The water rises a finger a year. Ask who digs the channels.
When a shaman speaks, the spears go down. Usually.
Kill clean, they say. Not all of them say it.
I keep three peoples from each other's throats. And yours.
Don't learn their tongue. They'll know who taught you.

current_business.brew: Water-breathing potions for the party (4-day brew)
current_business.ingredient_needed: Giant constrictor snake brain fluid — party tasked with retrieval (session 27)
current_business.dm_notes: Load-bearing for two arcs: the water-breathing brew (4-day clock) and the constrictor hunt (session 28 driver). Diplomatic keystone of the Luric marches — her neutrality keeps the three lizard-man tendencies from open war and keeps the swamp from raiding Caelrun.

campaign_notes: Deliver the upland herbs from Mother Yaleth (done, session 27); retrieve giant constrictor snake brain fluid for ring-lore; demonstrate respect for lizard-man tribal politics and the swamp's balance
